0022600020.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-3, 10th in the East, 3rd in the Central) visit the Miami Heat (1-4, 13th in the East) for their sixth game of the 2026-27 season in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. Indiana has lost its last two games and is 0-2 at home and 2-1 on the road, while Miami is 0-3 at home and enters on a one-game win streak. The Pacers will be without Tyrese Haliburton, Ivica Zubac, Obi Toppin, Ben Sheppard, Johnny Furphy and T.J. McConnell, and the teams have not met yet this season, though Indiana won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 135-118 win in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
